Name: CC Emily Edits for CP and Nyapu
Author: cajcbell
Description:
[center]﻿[/center][size=5][center][size=6][b]Emily Edits[/b][/size]

for CP and[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491] Nyapu Portraits[/url]﻿

Plus, optional standalone file if you only want the changes to her magical clothes!
[size=4]
This mod contains my personal edits to Emily, used during playthroughs where she becomes the farmer's wife.
It changes her sprites and 14-heart event rewards (visually only).
It contains portraits that can be copied to the main Nyapu folder (credit for the base portraits goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url]).

[b]Ideas taken into account for this edit:[/b]
[/size][size=3]
- Emily is a creative fashionista who makes her own clothes and would definitely make her own wedding dress
- Emily works at a saloon most nights of the week and needs to have her hair up (also, I like ponytails)
- Emily should look a little more like Haley's sister
- Emily's portraits should match the tone and color of her sprites a bit more
- Emily's 14-heart reward should feel a bit cooler to wear[/size][size=4]

[b]How to Use:[/b]
[/size][size=3]- Unzip the folder to the Mods folder
- Copy the images in the Portrait files folder to [CP] Nyapu Portraits and click "Yes" to overwrite files[/size][size=4]
[/size]
[b][size=4]Compatibility:[/size]
[/b][size=3]- Not compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Sprites[/url]﻿ or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22938]Seasonal Portraits[/url]
- Not compatible with other mods that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9952]edit Emily's appearance[/url]﻿

-
 I will not be adding seasonal or festival portraits, as I do not play with those - but anyone should feel free to create them on your own if you fall in love with this version of Emily!

She is a popular character for revamps and revisions, so if this doesn't tickle your fancy, I recommend you check out some of the other awesome Emily edits:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19285]Alex's Emily Sprite Edit[/url] (really well done artwork)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13453]New Outfit for Emily[/url] (a clean simple look)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9952]Emily Revised, Seasonal[/url]﻿ (standalone Emily edit from the larger SCA mod)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8245]Enhanced Emily (Revised)[/url]﻿ (a alternate version for SCA and DSV)
and, another good [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10832]Emily Wedding Dress[/url]﻿

[/size]-[/center][/size]
